name: Switch It Phase 1 static study

reference.use: Visual composition reference only; no video frames or audio embedded in the renderer

human.attribution: MakeHuman hm08; Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius, Jonas Hauquier

skull.construction: User-supplied Demon Mask GLB with original topology, UVs, normals and material maps retained. Runtime uses a solid, textured elevated overlay above the intact character.
skull.attribution: Demon Mask by egorova.e (https://sketchfab.com/silentegor), https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/demon-mask-e8f1ddf1cd344a50bdb4a30beaff8333; CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Textures resized; portrait registration and red lighting by DRMVYZ.
skull.textures: Three embedded 4096px maps resized to at most 1024px; no map removed.

mask.notes: Enlarged another 30% relative to the accepted 22% version, around the eye line. Horns extend beyond the fixed portrait frame. The character eyes remain at X +/-0.277; there are no added mask-eye disks.

quality: One development geometry tier. Production quality policies and measured GPU budgets belong to later phases.

compositing.baseCharacter: Always retained, including face, neck and shoulders
compositing.divider: Removed, including white seam core, halo and jagged clipping boundary

shadow.source: Projected silhouette of the supplied GLB triangles

compositing.surface: Full-opacity textured PBR interior; alpha blending is used only at the feathered reveal edge.
